brand.purpose: The large What Coffee footer signature only.

accent.purpose: One short expressive phrase per composition.

homeSectionTitle.purpose: The favorites, offerings, and reviews headings in one consistent Crafty Girls treatment.

shadows.name: tactile-action
shadows.purpose: Shared inset and outer depth for primary pill buttons.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Short state changes and image arrival.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-priority action on a composition.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg,#FA8D58 0%,#F17C46 58%,#D96735 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .52), inset 0 -3px 4px rgb(94 29 11 / .24), 0 2px 3px rgb(68 31 20 / .16), 0 9px 14px rgb(68 31 20 / .16); color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.4 Poppins, sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-primary-button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #111; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Image Label
components.description: A product image with a centered name and no surrounding card.
components.css: .ds-image-label { width: 220px; margin: 0; text-align: center; color: #111; font: 500 16px/1.3 Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-image-swatch { aspect-ratio: 4/5; border-radius: 18px; background: #EC814E; margin-bottom: 14px; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: A quiet, high-contrast field for contact details.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #111; font: 600 14px/1.4 Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #6B5B53; border-radius: 12px; background: #FAF6F1; color: #111; font: 400 16px/1.5 Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #EC814E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Footer Shell
components.description: Roasted orange utility footer with a large brand signature.
components.css: .ds-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 32px; padding: 48px; border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0; background: #BA4100; color: #F0ECE7; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; } .ds-footer strong { font-size: clamp(44px,7vw,88px); line-height: .95; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-footer span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: What Coffee should feel like walking up to a bright, friendly café counter: appetizing, direct, warm, and easy to understand. Real drinks, pastries, people, and the Santa Clara space carry the personality. The interface is minimalist without becoming sterile; every visible element must help someone choose, visit, order, or connect.
keyCharacteristics: Photography-led, with real café and product imagery.
Warm cream surfaces, confident orange, and strong ink contrast.
Poppins for clarity; Crafty Girls for the three core homepage content headings and short expressive phrases.
Simple compositions with generous space and restrained rounded corners.
Useful information stays visible, readable, and unobstructed.

rules.name: The Orange Commitment Rule
rules.body: Orange should occupy a decisive surface or action, not appear as scattered decorative specks.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Small text must reach WCAG AA. Use Roasted Orange—not Counter Orange—behind cream body text.

rules.name: The Homepage Section Title Rule
rules.body: The favorites, offerings, and reviews headings use Crafty Girls at the shared homepage title scale. The closing A few moments from the café title keeps its Poppins structure with a handwritten emphasis. Poppins remains the font for body copy, navigation, buttons, and content titles.

rules.name: The One Handwritten Phrase Rule
rules.body: Outside homepage section titles, use Crafty Girls for one short expressive phrase per major composition; never for paragraphs, menus, forms, or multiple competing labels.

rules.name: The Quiet Heading Rule
rules.body: Secondary-page headings cap around 3.75rem desktop and 2.75rem mobile. Only the What Coffee brand signature may be larger.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Content images, item labels, informational sections, and forms stay shadow-free.

dos: Do keep pages simple, minimalist, and content-first.
Do use real images as the primary visual material.
Do reserve generous neutral space between floating imagery and functional content.
Do keep practical café information easy to find.
donts: Don't add extra features, sections, CTAs, badges, or copy without a clear user need.
Don't wrap a simple image and name in a card or container.
Don't use oversized page or section headings.
Don't let decorative or overflow imagery cover functional content.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, decorative grids, stripe backgrounds, or sketchy illustrations.
